youtube.title: Circle of fourths: add a flat every step 🎼 #shorts

The same wheel read anticlockwise: C → F → B♭ → E♭ → A♭ … each step up in fourths adds one flat. Triads this time. Jazz players know this as the “cycle of fourths”.

hook.text: Twelve fifths should come home. They don’t.

youtube.title: Why 12 perfect fifths never close the circle 🤯 #shorts
youtube.description:
(3/2)^12 = 129.746… but 2^7 = 128. Twelve perfect fifths overshoot seven octaves by 23.46 cents (the Pythagorean comma). At the end you hear the starting C against the twelfth C: two notes that should be the same, beating. Equal temperament hides the gap by shrinking every fifth a tiny bit.

Which one should I do next? 👇

#shorts
